entry.title: Likely: Standard iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e arrive in spring 2027
entry.summary: Apple is splitting its iPhone releases: Pro and foldable models in fall, the standard iPhone 18 and 18e in spring.

entry.title: Confirmed: Honor 700 series launches in November with three models and a rear screen on every model
entry.summary: Honor will launch three Honor 700 models in China in November; every model has a built-in rear display, and the 700 Pro adds a stronger camera setup around a roughly 9,000mAh battery class.

entry.title: Confirmed: Samsung readies a Galaxy Fit 4 that looks just like the Fit 3
entry.summary: Samsung will launch a Galaxy Fit 4 (SM-R391) fitness band with a near-identical design to the Fit 3, in black, white and light blue, at a similar low price.

entry.title: Rumor: Samsung cuts Galaxy A phone production by about 20% to protect flagships
entry.summary: Samsung has cut fourth-quarter Galaxy A component orders by about 20% versus its plan, about 10 million phones a year, and plans to cut Galaxy A output by more than 10% again in 2027, shifting resources to flagships as memory costs soar.

entry.title: Likely: Apple launches an OLED iPad Air, a vapor-chamber iPad Pro and an A19 base iPad in the first half of 2027
entry.summary: Apple will release three iPads in the first half of 2027: an iPad Air with an OLED screen, an iPad Pro with a new chip and vapor-chamber cooling, and a base iPad with the A19, 8GB of RAM (enabling Apple Intelligence), the N1 wireless chip and the C1X modem.

entry.title: Rumor: Apple makes Siri AI a proactive agent as early as 2027
entry.summary: Apple will turn Siri AI into an agent that tracks goals and carries out multi-step tasks on its own, like OpenAI's Dots or Meta's Muse, possibly as soon as next year.

entry.title: Rumor: Xiaomi 19 series mixes flat and curved screens
entry.summary: Development of Xiaomi's next flagship series has started, and the lineup will include both flat and curved cover glass.

entry.title: Rumor: Samsung skips new Galaxy Watches in 2027 and moves to a two-year cycle
entry.summary: Samsung will not release new Galaxy Watch models in 2027, ending yearly launches that began in 2018; the Galaxy Watch 9 and Watch Ultra 2 stay current until 2028, existing watches get software and health updates, and a new Galaxy Fit band fills the gap.

entry.title: Likely: MacBook Neo 2 with A19 Pro and 12GB of RAM arrives around March 2027
entry.summary: Apple's second MacBook Neo moves from the A18 Pro with 8GB of RAM to the A19 Pro with 12GB and launches in the iOS/macOS 27.4 window (February-March 2027), possibly in new colors; Apple plans to refresh the Neo's colors often.

entry.title: Likely: iQOO 16R (or 16s) uses the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4
entry.summary: The vivo I2606, believed to be the iQOO 16R or iQOO 16s, runs a Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 with 12GB of RAM on Android 17, a step down from the iQOO 15R's Snapdragon 8 Gen 5.

entry.title: Rumor: Moore Threads Lushan has 64GB of VRAM, the most on a consumer graphics card
entry.summary: Moore Threads' Lushan GPU will carry 64GB of graphics memory, twice the RTX 5090's 32GB and the highest of any consumer card.

entry.title: Likely: TSMC holds some 16nm-and-below shipments under new US export rules
entry.summary: TSMC has paused some shipments of 16nm/14nm-and-newer chips to Chinese (and some non-Chinese) designers while it checks compliance with a new US BIS rule that presumes such chips are controlled unless their performance is certified, which could hit phone, TV and car chips.

entry.title: Rumor: iPhone Duo cover screen gets a column of Lock Screen widgets
entry.summary: Apple has tested a 'complication column' on the iPhone Duo's cover-screen Lock Screen that fits two circular widgets on the right edge, below the status icons.

entry.title: Rumor: Apple unveils smart glasses at WWDC 2027
entry.summary: Apple will show privacy-focused smart glasses at WWDC 2027 and ship them in late 2027.

entry.title: Rumor: vivo S70 launches soon with a 64MP periscope that supports a teleconverter
entry.summary: vivo's next S-series phone, the S70, has a 64MP Sony LYT-610 periscope telephoto with support for a 200mm teleconverter, a 6.59-inch 1.5K LTPS OLED screen and the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4.

entry.title: Likely: Galaxy S27 moves the Now Bar to a centered, Dynamic Island-style pill
entry.summary: Samsung will move Now Bar live notifications from beside the clock to the top center around the selfie camera, switch between activities with sideways swipes, and add a 'Moment effects' page (Sports first).

entry.title: Likely: Motorola readies a 'Moto Tag 3' that is a Moto Tag 2 in new colors
entry.summary: Motorola will sell a Moto Tag 3 tracker in Lucent White and Indigo Blue with the same UWB, Find Hub support, IP rating, CR2032 battery (500+ days) and 8.5g weight as the Moto Tag 2.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27 prices come in above Samsung's earlier internal targets
entry.summary: Samsung is weighing Galaxy S27 launch prices higher than it originally planned because mobile memory costs keep climbing.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27 adds 'Gen Video' and 'Shorts' AI video tools, with only a few free generations
entry.summary: Galaxy S27 phones get Gen Video (prompt- and preset-based AI video generation) and an opt-in Shorts tool that turns up to 30 photos into a video; after three free videos, users must buy credits or a Pro/Premium plan.

entry.title: Rumor: Rapidus misses its 2nm SRAM milestone, putting 2027 mass production at risk
entry.summary: Japan's Rapidus failed to show working SRAM cells on its 2nm GAA process by its summer 2026 target and is fighting cleanroom contamination, which threatens its plan to start mass production in 2027.

entry.title: Rumor: Hyundai readies an all-new electric Porter work truck for 2027
entry.summary: Hyundai's next-generation Porter pickup is fully electric, with a short hood for better crash protection, and could be sold globally as early as next year.

entry.title: Rumor: vivo brings budget Y21s 5G, Y11s 5G and Y05s 4G phones to India
entry.summary: Three entry-level vivo phones share a 6.74-inch 720p 120Hz LCD and 6,500mAh battery: the Y21s 5G (Dimensity 6300, 50MP camera, 44W), Y11s 5G (Dimensity 6300, 13MP, 15W, 4GB/128GB) and Y05s 4G (UNISOC T7225, single 8MP camera, 4GB/64GB).

entry.title: Likely: Huawei Watch Air is a 6.9mm titanium smartwatch with up to 5 days of battery
entry.summary: Huawei's upcoming Watch Air has a 6.9mm titanium unibody, an irregular high-silicon stacked battery (over 10% silicon) for up to five days of use, Watch GT 7 Pro-level activity tracking and Watch 6 sensors including ECG.

entry.title: Rumor: Honor Magic V7 is a wide foldable, with no regular-shaped Magic V model next year
entry.summary: Honor's next book-style foldable, the Magic V7, uses a wide form factor, and Honor won't release a conventional tall foldable alongside it.

entry.title: Likely: Motorola Razr Flex 2027 uses an unreleased Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 Pro
entry.summary: The Razr Flex 2027 (XT2761, codename Parker), a compact wide foldable, runs Android 17 on Qualcomm's unannounced SM8845 Pro chip, with an under-display fingerprint reader and Bluetooth 6.0.

entry.title: Rumor: HMD revives Nokia's PureView name on a Schneider-Kreuznach camera phone
entry.summary: HMD is preparing a camera-focused phone carrying the PureView brand, with a large round quad-camera module including a periscope and Schneider-Kreuznach branding.

entry.title: Rumor: Honor launches a mid-range X-series phone with a ~13,500mAh battery before Chinese New Year
entry.summary: Honor's next X-series phone is a mid-ranger with about 13,500mAh of battery and a 6.96- or 7-inch screen, launching before Chinese New Year; Honor is also speeding up the Power3 with a new 7-inch screen and bigger battery.

entry.title: Likely: Microsoft's Link to Windows turns Android phones and tablets into a PC second screen
entry.summary: An 'Extend display' feature in Link to Windows will let a Windows PC use an Android phone or tablet as an extended monitor, streaming the desktop as H.264/HEVC video.

entry.title: Likely: Intel's 16-core Nova Lake-H laptop chip: 4.8GHz, 18MB cache, DDR5-8000, 25W
entry.summary: A 16-core Nova Lake-H chip (8 P-cores, 4 E-cores, 4 low-power E-cores) runs up to 4.8GHz turbo and 2.0GHz base with 18MB of last-level cache, a 2.3GHz iGPU, DDR5-8000 support up to 128GB and a 25W TDP.

entry.title: Shaky: Xiaomi 18 Max gets the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and a battery over 8,000mAh
entry.summary: Xiaomi is polishing a big-screen 'Xiaomi 18 Max' with Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and a battery above 8,000mAh, succeeding the 17 Max.
